tokens.json.becomes: adopted: the kernel's tokens, by the same hash; canvas passes dropped

revisions.becomes: adopted: card versions as history at negative revisions

pairing.json.becomes: dropped: a pairing code lives ten minutes

trash.becomes: kept: the folder deck's trash is .decks/trash

migrations.json.becomes: kept: the deck's version record, read and moved on by upgrade

agents.becomes: adopted: meta.json into people's store (upgrade 0.6.0); chat.json, chat.log and meta's resumeRef, model, mode, account into the harness's own file when a harness adopts the agent (harness/sessions/deck-history.ts), reached through chat.list; all kept as is in the deck until harnesses have read them; models.json dropped (a cache)

authors.json.becomes: adopted: cards upgrade, claims/<card> in the cards store; reached through card.get's by

heights.json.becomes: dropped: fitted heights of old root pages, which are not cards; a card's size is its box and its meta; backed up

seen.json.becomes: adopted: cards upgrade, seen/<card> in the cards store; reached through card.get

canvases.becomes: dropped: the shared canvases of 2026-09-22, read only by that day's migration; left on disk untouched

ports.json.becomes: adopted: apps upgrade, ports.json in the apps store; reached through port.list

apps.becomes: adopted: <name>.log as log/<name> in the apps store (last 600 lines), reached through app.logs; <name>.built dropped (builds run in the machine folder)

thumbs.becomes: dropped: a cache of card pictures, retaken as asked

shots.becomes: kept as is: agents' throwaway screenshots, left unshown

studio.json.becomes: adopted: sharing upgrade, 'link' in the sharing store; reached through studio.status

studio-sync.json.becomes: adopted: sharing upgrade, 'state' in the sharing store, canvases keyed by folder; owners and inventory rebuilt

studio-hashes.json.becomes: dropped: a hash cache; the new sync client hashes files as it goes

sync.becomes: adopted: sharing upgrade, base/<id> for the ids the state names; orphans stay behind
